column1: # Frozen surface x visibility matrix — transcribed from
# § "Frozen surface × visibility matrix" (Accepted by the owner 2026-09-20).
# THIS FILE IS THE FIXTURE, NOT A MIRROR OF THE CODE. It is transcribed from the
# ADR table. TestFrozenMatrix drives internal/authz.Evaluator.Decide with every
# row and compares. A change to the evaluator that is not also a change to the
# ADR turns this red; a change to the ADR must be transcribed here in the same
# PR. 21 surfaces x 3 visibilities x 5 viewer classes = 315 expectations.
#   M = signed-in member without a grant
#   G = holder of a valid grant on the item or on an album containing it
#   S = staff (admin/manager) acting in an AUDITED administration context
# Conditions held at their base values for this table; each is varied by its own
#   owner has listed the item for IPFS    (row 18)
#   staff role = admin, not site owner    (row 19)
# Row 4 (album page) is governed by ALBUM privacy, not item visibility, so its
# three columns drive album privacy public / link / private respectively — that
# is what "same rule (not split by item visibility)" means in the ADR.
# 1. Item page and API item read: public "all"; unlisted "all, with the URL"; private "O G S"
# 2. Original download: gated by the owner's download setting (here: all), then by visibility
# 3. Derivative URLs: public shared-cacheable; unlisted token-bearing and proxied; private proxied O G S
# 4. Album page: album privacy governs. Columns drive album privacy public / link / private.
# 5. Counts: an unlisted or private item never contributes to a count shown to A or M
# 6. Owner library: O, and S in an audited admin context, at every visibility
# 7. Profile grid of another user: public only
# 8. Explore, random, trending, featured: public only
# 9. Search and suggestions, site scope. Grants do not extend to search.
# 10. Tag and category listings: public only
# 12. Notifications: delivered only to recipients who may see the item
# 13. Favorite count and rating aggregate: private aggregates are visible to O/S only
# 14. oEmbed, Open Graph, embed codes: a private item has none at all
# 16. Bulk/zip download: only items the viewer may see
# 17. Federation outbound (ActivityPub): never published unless public
# 18. IPFS publication: eligible only with a listed owner, and only when public
# 19. Export: O's own everything; site export by OWNER role (admin is not enough), audited
# 20. Admin console and moderation: S only, with audit, at every visibility
# 21. Caches and CDN: only public derivatives are shared-cacheable
